prepareWarm.what: prepare a typical one-line rule, warm service cache (Node), median

prepareCold.what: first prepare in a fresh process: new schema, production parser mode

runLocal.what: run a prepared rule that needs no data (Node), median

rerun100.what: re-run 100 prepared local rules after one field changes (worker code in Node), total

runCorrelated.what: run a correlated rule with one data call (PGlite), without database time, median

workerGzip.what: browser worker bundle, gzip (H5 measured 184160 bytes, plus 10%)
